messages:
Amaya: heading to Singapore for 10 days next week. debating carry-on-only vs checking a bag. have toiletries and a laptop. worried about cramped overheads + souvenirs. thoughts? :airplane:
Diego: for 10 days I usually check. less stress, can bring shoes and a jacket. downside = wait time + risk of delay/lost bag. if tight connection -> carry-on.
Hannah: carry-on is doable if you commit to 5 outfits and do laundry once. also carry an inflatable daypack for souvenirs. I always use packing cubes and roll + compression socks.
Rory: quick rules to decide:
- if you need >1 pair of shoes => check
- power banks MUST go in carry-on (TSA rule)
- liquids >100ml go in checked (or buy on arrival)
- checked bag gives you flexibility but add 30-60min at both ends
luggage-bot: FYI airline allowance: Economy on most carriers = 1 personal + 1 carry-on up to 7kg-10kg; check your airline policy before you pack. link: https://airline.example/check-baggage
Diego: also consider luggage locks: tsa-approved if flying via US. tag your case with a bright ribbon. doubles as identifying marker.
Hannah: packing cheat code (carry-on only):
```
- 1 pair versatile shoes (wear the bulkiest on plane)
- 5 tops (mix dressy + casual)
- 2 bottoms that match most tops
- travel-size toiletries + solid shampoo bar
- compact travel towel + quick-dry socks
- laptop + charger + power bank (carry-on)
- small ziplock for liquids (100ml rule)
```
Amaya: good call on buying extra liquids locally. worried about humid weather + sweaty shirts though.
Rory: pack one merino tee (odor resistant) and a lightweight packable jacket. merino = travel miracle. also hand-sanitizer and small lint roller.
Diego: pro tip: put an outfit in your personal item in case checked bag is delayed. saved me once. :sunglasses:
Amaya: ok plan: carry-on with a small checked bag backup (if souvenirs overflow). will wear the big shoes on the plane and pack merino. thanks y'all! :heart:
